_doc: A smooth (toothless) GT2 idler, sold as "20 tooth size", with ball bearings for 6 mm belt and a 5 mm bore: community until measured. Its running surface diameter is not published. Run it on the back of the belt: Gates's smallest smooth idler on the teeth side is 25.4 mm, its smallest back-side idler 12.7 mm.
